Despite only using it one one device, we are continually signed out each time we close it. On top of all of that, its very laggy. If this were a free, non profit app, I would take this lack of quality with a grain of salt, but when a year subscription is over 100$, there is no excuse for the utter lack of effort or improvement put into this. Updating the accessibility and acclimating servers to the amount of viewership some games draw could greatly improve this experience. As the average rating for this app is 1.6 stars, I know i’m not the only one to share this sentiment. That being said, it’s clear that this is nothing but a money grab. I continue to watch games on this deplorable platform only to justify paying such an outrageous amount, but next year i’ll stick to the FREE youtube livestreams I can find instead.

title: Nearly unusable
body: This isn’t just a review of the app, it’s a review of the service as a whole. It doesn’t matter where you watch or how fast the internet you watch it on is, the stream is guaranteed to be bad. Imagine watching your favorite team - they’re about to score and *glitch* - you missed the play. About once every minute, the BIG10+ livestream glitches and either moves a second or two back, or a second or two forward and you missed what happened. A reliable live stream is the absolute bare minimum for a streaming service, but somehow they can’t cut it. I’m sure I’ll get a developer response like “oh wow we’re so sorry, I’m sure we can figure this out with our support team!” Spoiler alert: they can’t. Support has proven to be wildly useless and unable to even read the tickets. We’ll lay out every single detail of the issue and they just read the first sentence, reply with a poorly written and irrelevant support article, and close the ticket. You might also be reading this and think “my internet is usually pretty reliable, I’m sure it’ll work fine for me”. Maybe. I really hope it does. But myself and my BIG10 fan relatives have pretty well proven that it’s a stream issue. I work in IT and have an enterprise network at my home. It is insanely reliable and every other streaming service, live included, works beautifully. My relatives have a fairly high-end mesh network and gigabit fiber and they also have the same issues on their BIG10+ accounts. Same story on 5G using AT&T and T-Mobile. And that’s just the tech issues. The announcers are as dull as it gets, mispronouncing everyone’s names and just being generally uninteresting. Some games have very little court/field sound so you don’t feel as much a part of the action as you do on other channels. I dread when games are only on BIG10+, it’s just an all around poor experience. To anyone looking to download and subscribe: You’ve been warned, but I also get that if you’re a super fan, you either subscribe or you don’t get to watch at all. I really hope it works for you, but if not, at least you can request a refund if you subscribe through Apple. To the developers: I hope you can take this feedback to your team and actually figure out what’s wrong. Clearly it’s been an issue for a long time based on the reviews here so I’m not holding my breath, but you’re destroying the reputation of the BIG10, making people subscribe to yet another service to watch their teams and then doing a poor job with it.

title: All kinds of issues
body: Update 11/5/23: App is still very problematic. They seem to have fixed the ATV crashing problems (mostly). The newest bug they’ve introduced is that if you pause the video on ATV long enough for the screensaver to kick in, the video starts over when you unpause. So no going to the bathroom or upstairs to grab another beer. Response to the Developer’s response: my ATV and my version of the app are up-to-date. Unfortunately the problems won’t be that easy to fix. Original review: The App is very poor on both the iPad and Apple TV. On ATV the app repeatedly crashes when trying to start an on demand game. I had to retry 6 times and it finally worked when I skipped ahead a couple of minutes into the game immediately after hitting play. The search function is horrible. I searched for a specific game and it only offered me the condensed version. And that was only after applying filters for sport and school. I finally found the full game by randomly scrolling. The video quality is also not great. I have gigabit internet and every other app on my ATV and iPad stream 4K / high res video flawlessly. The Big10 app has trouble maintaining high res. The stream frequently pixelated and reverts to a lower res while it presumable buffers data for higher quality. I also have to keep careful track of where I’m at in the game because pushing a button on the ATV remote sometimes causes the game to start over at the beginning. Lastly, in past seasons they condensed football games down to 60 minutes. That was great. Now it seems to be 20 minutes. That’s too condensed to really understand the flow and details of the game. It is more of a long highlight reel than a condensed game. Overall this is a very poorly designed and executed app that is serving content that is sometimes poorly produced. It’s disappointing since this is the only option for me to follow my favorite Big 10 teams.

title: Bad UI + poor picture quality
body: TL;DR: I have a one month subscription and I won’t be renewing. The UI is incredibly frustrating and the picture (for TV viewing) is painful. My full review … UI: hard fail. The 3 most common searches/filters should be prominent: A) by team; B) by sport; C) by date. Those filters don’t exist. Instead you’re bombarded with a ton of garbage content (e.g., “Classic Games”) and it takes forever to find what you’re looking for. Live Viewing: on the positive side, you can go to a live game that’s already in progress and start from the beginning. However: 1) if you start that game you’re immediately taken to the game in progress. (Where you will probably see the score.) There should be two options when starting a live game that’s already in progress: A) go to live game, or B) start from the beginning. 2) If you are watching a game on “delay” you better catch up. If the game ends before you catch up to live it will stop playing, and you’ll have to wait until the next day to watch the rest of the game. (Found that out the hard way.) Picture Quality: I don’t know but I’m guessing the picture quality on phone/tablet/laptop is probably fine. On a TV? Terrible. For those of you old enough to remember 480p resolution on TVs … it’s worse than that: blurry and a fair amount of stutter. I’ve watched games via my Apple TV box on a 55-inch TV, the same setup where I can watch 4K movies/shows via Apple TV+, HBO Max, etc without issue. I also get ~200Mbps download speed. The issue is clearly on the BTN+ server side were they seem to be throttling bandwidth and/or doing TONS of compression. I even ran some speed tests on my laptop WHILE streaming a game and could see I was still getting over 180Mbps. Even if BTN+ completely overhauled their app to make it usable I don’t think I would resubscribe. The PQ — for TV viewing — is so bad it’s barely watchable.

Unfortunately, I’ll have to cancel my service because I’m not getting what I pay for. Lastly, the UI design is terrible. I have to click my Apple TV Remote probably 20+ times before I perform enough filters to get to the game I want to watch. The idea behind this app is very promising. The execution technically speaking and in TV contract rights (to show all games of big ten teams in this app) need to catch up. I do enjoy the app once I start watching a game though.
